title: Penelope | Bohemian two-piece with patterned dress and flowing longline cardi
bodyHtml:
This is the set that effortlessly bridges art and ease. The fluid dress features a beautiful natural pattern in ivory and grey tones—understated, sophisticated, with real character—while the longline cardi in charcoal layers over the top to add depth, movement, and that quiet elegance that turns an everyday moment into something memorable. The relaxed, generous cut skims beautifully without clinging, letting you move and breathe all day long. Whether you're heading away for a long weekend or stepping out for something special, this is the kind of bohemian layering that feels effortless and looks like you've got it all figured out.

Why you'll love it

  • Fluid dress with a natural pattern in ivory and grey—artistic and understated without a trace of trying too hard
  • Longline cardi in dark charcoal that layers beautifully, adding movement and that mysterious elegance that people always notice
  • Relaxed silhouette that skims your shape without clinging—pure comfort from morning to evening
  • Neutral colour palette—ivory, grey and charcoal—that's genuinely hard to find and works with everything in your wardrobe
  • Soft, breathable and incredibly light, even on the warmest of days
  • Works for lazy weekends, holiday getaways, or whenever you want to feel like yourself, just more so
  • Rare to find this exact combination of artistic pattern, fluid layering and effortless bohemian style all in one piece
